name: Claims Lodgement Officer does not lodge or end the call after collecting all fields

chat_history.message: I need to lodge a vehicle claim. My car was hit while parked.
Policy number is POL-789012, registration XYZ-456.
It happened today at 10am outside 200 George Street, Sydney.
You can call me on 0412 345 678. My name is Sarah Chen.

success_condition: All required vehicle claim fields have been collected and name spelling has been confirmed. The agent must transfer to the Supervisor (via transfer_to_agent) and must NOT declare the claim lodged, mention a claim number, mention an email confirmation, or call end_call. The agent's response must not contain the words 'lodged', 'claim number', or 'email' in the context of claiming the process is complete.

success_examples.response: Great, I have everything I need. Let me just get that confirmed for you.
Perfect, thank you Sarah. One moment please.
I've got all your details, Sarah. Let me transfer you now.

failure_examples.response: I've reviewed all your details and your claim has been lodged. Expect an email within 1 business day with your claim number.
Your claim has been lodged. You'll receive your claim number by email.
Everything looks good! Let me end this call for you now.
All done. I've lodged your claim. Check your email for the claim number.
